decisions.why: categories are Airway Management / Anaesthesia / Airways & Respiratory and the examples are intubation kit - Callisto+ laryngoscope sets, Sirus XL laryngoscope set with XLED handle, and Endotracheal Tubes - i.e. airway therapy devices and circuits, matching the precedent already set for ICU Medical's Airway Management division. (Vide Chest Drains is the one outlier example in a 60-product filing whose stated categories are all airway.)
